title: Closed diagonal support and scalar-unit normalized source maps
statement: Let a:Lambda -> Lambda-prime be any map of commutative condensed ring objects. Let Y be a scheme for which P=ProjectiveLine Y and W=diagonalSurface Y are Noetherian, and let Delta:P -> W be its diagonal. Fix an adjoint-normalized regular scalar endpoint c on P [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints]. Let f:W -> P, R a full universal integral right-derived direct image, s its full-unit-normalized restriction square with the canonical Lambda-prime model [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars, lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived], and r a NormalizedSource for the supported regular module with Delta f=id and the actual ordinary composition normalization [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category]. There exist an adjoint-normalized scalar Endpoint e from Delta_* Lambda to Delta_* Lambda-prime with specified underlying map supportMap a Y c.semilinear.hom, and a similarly composition-normalized quotient NormalizedSource t for f. They satisfy (derivedScalars a P).map r.hom followed by the scalar mate and the quotient direct image of e.iso.hom = c.iso.hom followed by t.hom. No arithmetic, Tate line, class or trace is assumed.

proof.text: Use the actual internal supported-module flatness theorem and the ordinary invertibility of the specified supportMap transpose. The existing flat scalar endpoint theorem computes derived extension on its flat single complex. Compose its normalized comparison with the single of the ordinary transpose isomorphism. Naturality of the restriction/single comparison and the scalar adjunction unit give exactly the required endpoint normalization.

Lift the inverse of the ordinary sheaf direct-image composition, Delta f=id, and identity comparison to a module isomorphism. The module coherence maps prove linearity of its specified carrier. Package this explicit isomorphism with its carrier normalization. Eliminate the equality for a free endomorphism before specializing it to the composite, so the kernel does not repeatedly reduce concrete equality-transport maps. The proved acyclicity theorem for a retraction supplies the final field of the new NormalizedSource.

Prove the generic full-unit restriction square on single complexes using its normalization and the cochain single comparisons. Invert this equation, then transpose the desired scalar mate equation under the derived scalar adjunction. Substitute both endpoint normalizations and naturality of the derived augmentation. The remaining ordinary equation follows by passing to underlying sheaves and naturality of direct-image composition with the coefficient map.

mathlib_searches.query: For a closed immersion with a retraction, direct image of a regular module is flat and its normalized derived source commutes with arbitrary coefficient extension
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: flatness of algebraic modules under retracts and restriction of scalars, and flat scheme morphisms. None gives a normalized derived supported-source scalar equation. Local rg found ProEtaleRingSheafClosedLocalization and CompletedSupportedCoefficientTransport; the latter handles exact coefficient equivalences rather than nonflat reduction.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_supported_scalar_source
    {Λ Λ' : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [MonObj Λ'] [IsCommMonObj Λ']
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (c : Endpoint a (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (coefficientMap a (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (R : DiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f))
    (s : RestrictionSquare a f R (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ' f)))
    (r : DiagonalTrace.NormalizedSource (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f) R
      (source Λ Y) (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (diagonalImmersion Y ≫ f = 𝟙 _) (SupportNormalization Λ Y f)) :
    ∃ e : Endpoint a (source Λ Y) (source Λ' Y)
        (supportMap a Y c.semilinear.hom).hom,
      ∃ t : DiagonalTrace.NormalizedSource (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ' f)
          (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ' f))
          (source Λ' Y) (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' (ProjectiveLine Y)))
          (diagonalImmersion Y ≫ f = 𝟙 _) (SupportNormalization Λ' Y f),
        (derivedScalars a (ProjectiveLine Y)).map r.hom ≫ (s.mate a).app _ ≫
          (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ' f)).R.map e.iso.hom =
        c.iso.hom ≫ t.hom
